gotchas: Guest booking works. Flow: homepage /us/en/homepage flight search -> 'Please select your departure' -> expand the 'Economy from EUR ...' fare tab -> 'Select Economy Light and continue' -> Green Fare popup 'Continue with my selection' -> Your selection 'Continue with current fare' -> Extra services (skip) 'Enter passenger details' -> passenger form 'Confirm and continue' -> 'Continue to payment' (enabled once 'Creating your cart' finishes) -> payment hub.

Homepage search: Type of trip combobox -> 'One-way'; From/To inputs input[name="flightQuery.flightSegments[0].originCode"] / [...].destinationCode (prefilled origin): clear, type the city and click the option containing the IATA code (FRA, MUC). The date picker is a modal: click the day number, then 'Continue', then 'Find flights' (the click can take ~60s to return while the booking app loads).

Passenger form: Title is a mat-select (click, then option 'Ms.'), input[formcontrolname=firstName] / [formcontrolname=lastName], input.contact-info-email-input, country calling code input[aria-describedby=countryCodes] (defaults to the egress country; type 'United States' and pick '(+1)'), input.contact-info-phone-input.
2026-10-17: the passenger form's Title mat-select is a required field; the vault has no title field yet, so the passenger step has no token for it.

Payment runs on the top-level host paymenthub.lufthansa.com (not an iframe): choose the 'Credit / Debit Card' radio, Manual Card Entry tab. Card number, name, expiry (single MM/YY text field, type it) and security code are plain inputs in the page.
Billing street input has maxlength 35 and truncated a long street line (fill_rejected); zip and city filled fine. A 'Country: no selection' button must also be set before paying.
Order total: .price-information-card-price resolves (EUR 229.63). Final button is 'Pay now' behind Terms and Privacy checkboxes - never click it.
